svg.title: Comprehensive local LLM proxy architecture
svg.desc: Full architecture showing client, single Python process containing FastAPI, privacy engine with session map, provider router with LiteLLM library, response de-obfuscator, external providers, and support services

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What clients connect to the local LLM proxy?')
g.text: Client (Claude Code · any OpenAI-SDK app · curl)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the FastAPI gateway handle in the proxy?')
g.text: OpenAI-compatible routes · session ID header · StreamingResponse

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the privacy engine obfuscate sensitive data?')
g.text: swap backend via config, zero code change

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the session map store the obfuscation mapping?')
g.text: shared across all turns in one session
cleared on session end / process restart

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the LiteLLM library do inside the provider router?')
g.text: translates to each provider wire format · retry · fallback

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the model alias config work?')
sendPrompt('How does the response de-obfuscator handle streaming chunks?')
g.text: Response de-obfuscator — stream-safe lookahead buffer · [ENTITY_N] → original
